title: "I'm a DROPOUT, not 12th-fail"
lines: Chat: "Does your girlfriend know you're 12th-fail?"
First of all — I am NOT 12th-fail.
OK? There's a difference.
I left 12th myself. By my own choice.
That's called a DROPOUT — not "fail"!
(bleep)
Second thing — do you even know?
She knows, bro.
I saw some emotional video someone made about me:
"Carry Minati — you must have heard the name…
…famous across the country and the world…
…found success early — despite being 12th-fail."
I got SO angry.
I said I'll smack you —
wind up and SMACK you. "12th fail."
(bleep)
Bro, dropout and fail are VERY different.

title: Mansion heist goes wrong → Ruby Lambo escape
hook: Stealing a Lambo from a mansion in GTA 6…
lines: Wait. I don't want to leave ANYTHING behind here.
(bleep)!
Oh (bleep), bro — now we have to RUN!
If I don't run now, I lose it all!
We're SCREWED!
(bleep) (bleep) (bleep)!
We're screwed — GET OUT, get out, get out!
Get out of here!
Oh bro — this car is FAST!
This car is really fast — move, move, MOVE!
WOW. This car is SO fast, bro!
Bro, DRIVE!
Are you kidding me?! Way TOO fast!
I don't even know how it's driving.

title: Chat votes SELL, then regrets it — "this is literally politics"
hook: Chat voted to SELL his Lambo… then changed its mind
lines: "Don't sell it"? Then why'd you say SELL before?!
Why'd you say "sell it" before?
Why'd you say it before?!
Why are you being such clowns, bro?
What? This guy came to fight me, bro —
I didn't even say anything to him! What's his problem?
Bro, it's LITERALLY become politics.
Just like in politics —
you vote for one guy, then "we never wanted him!
Shouldn't have voted for him — why did he win?"
That's literally what you guys are doing.
Then why did you VOTE?
Weren't you at the polling booth? Were you sitting at home?!
